title: Short: D. B. Cooper (hijacker who vanished, 3D+2D style)

lines.text: Why the FBI never found this man.
In 1971, a quiet man in a suit boarded a flight to Seattle.
He handed the flight attendant a note. He had a bomb.
He wanted two hundred thousand dollars, and four parachutes.
In Seattle, he swapped the passengers for the money.
Then, at night, in a storm, he jumped out of the back of the plane.
Nine years later, a boy found five thousand eight hundred dollars of it by a river.
The rest was never found. And neither was he.
